title: Dan Dan Noodles
description: Dan Dan Noodles are a classic Sichuan dish featuring springy Chinese wheat noodles coated in a rich, spicy, nutty sauce made with sesame paste, Sichuan chili oil, black vinegar, and fragrant Sichuan pepper. Topped with savory crispy ground pork, spring onions, peanuts, and sesame seeds, this restaurant-style preparation delivers a layered balance of heat, umami, acidity, and aromatic richness.

ingredients.title: For the Dan Dan Sauce
items: Sichuan chili oil – 3 tbsp, preferably with chili sediment
Sesame paste – 2 tbsp (tahini may be used as a substitute)
Sichuan peppercorns – 1 tsp, toasted and ground

ingredients.title: For the Spicy Meat Topping
items: Ground pork – 200 g (7 oz), or ground beef
Chili flakes – 1 tsp (optional, for extra heat)

ingredients.title: For the Noodles
items: Fresh Chinese wheat noodles – 400 g (14 oz), thin or medium

instruction.title: Step 1 – Preparing the Dan Dan Sauce
steps: Add sesame paste, soy sauce, black vinegar, Sichuan chili oil, sugar, ground Sichuan pepper, garlic, ginger, and white pepper to a small bowl.
Whisk thoroughly until the sauce becomes smooth and emulsified.
If the sauce is too thick, gradually whisk in 1–2 tbsp hot water until it reaches a pourable consistency.
Taste and adjust the balance of heat, acidity, saltiness, and sesame richness.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Preparing the Spicy Meat Topping
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a wok or skillet over medium heat.
Add the ground pork and break it apart with a spatula.
Cook until the meat begins to brown.
Add soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, sugar, and chili flakes if using.
Continue cooking for approximately 5–6 minutes until the pork is deeply browned and slightly crisp around the edges.
Remove from the heat and keep warm.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Cooking the Noodles
steps: Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil.
Add the fresh Chinese wheat noodles and cook according to their thickness until al dente.
Drain thoroughly and rinse briefly under warm water to remove excess surface starch.
Shake off excess water so the sauce remains concentrated when the noodles are assembled.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Assembling the Dan Dan Noodles
steps: Divide the prepared sauce between serving bowls.
Place the hot cooked noodles directly over the sauce.
Top each portion with the spicy ground pork.
Add chopped spring onions, crushed roasted peanuts, and sesame seeds.
Add blanched bok choy or spinach if desired.
Toss the noodles thoroughly just before eating so the sauce coats every strand evenly.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve immediately in warm bowls while the noodles are hot.
Pair with Chinese cucumber salad, steamed greens, or vegetable dumplings.
Add pickled mustard greens for extra acidity, texture, and traditional Sichuan character.
Serve with additional Sichuan chili oil at the table for guests who prefer more heat.

chefTips: Use homemade Sichuan chili oil when possible; infusing the oil with chili flakes, garlic, and Sichuan peppercorns gives superior depth.
Toast Sichuan peppercorns lightly before grinding to maximize their citrusy aroma and characteristic numbing sensation.
Taste the sauce before combining it with the noodles and adjust heat, vinegar, salt, or sesame paste as needed.
Fresh Chinese wheat noodles provide the best chewy texture and absorb the sauce particularly well.
Cook noodles only until al dente so they retain enough structure to carry the rich sauce.
Cook the ground pork until slightly crisp to create a textural contrast against the soft, coated noodles.
For a more authentic texture, use chili oil containing visible chili sediment rather than completely strained oil.
Serve immediately after assembly because the noodles absorb the sauce quickly and are best enjoyed hot.
